'''H4-W2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] active around the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]] it transmitted an emergency signal to field operatives, urging them to respond to the Code Omega event.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|Ziost}}</ref> It later broadcast a priority message from [[Darth Marr]] to rally a hunt for [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]].<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
